scope: Proposition 6.3 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let T be normal compact Kähler and globally Weil Q-factorial, with canonical sheaf a rational line bundle. Let B ≥ 0 be a real boundary with (T, B) klt. Assume the rational ordinary-step result of Proposition 3.4 for T and its subsequent models. Then every (KT + B)- negative extremal analytic ray has an ordinary step with projective contractions, compact Kähler models, and the expected opposite relative ample signs. Global Weil factoriality is preserved; global strong factoriality is preserved when imposed initially.
